features: Type-C Charging & Up to 10 Days Battery Life: The boAt Ultima Vogue 2 brings the ultimate convenience of direct Type-C charging. It instantly zeros out the cable clutter from your ecosystem, letting you use the exact same Type-C cable that powers your phone or laptop. Packed with up to 10 days of battery support and a smart Power Saving Mode, it ensures you stay powered up without constant recharge.

1. 1.96” (4.97 cm) AMOLED Display: Equipped with a stunning 1.96” AMOLED display, Ultima Vogue 2 offers crystal-clear visibility in any environment. Whether you are checking workout stats mid-run or reading notifications, the vibrant 410 x 502 resolution and 1000 nits peak brightness make every pixel pop. Plus, with Always-On Display (AOD), stay updated with just a glance without waking your screen.

Functional Crown & Metal Build: Housed in a premium metallic frame, it makes navigation a cakewalk, letting you adjust settings or change watch faces smoothly without ever blocking your view. Switch between multiple menu styles and glide through endless features with a simple tactile twist using the Functional Crown.

IP68 Waterproofing: Built tough with an IP68 rating, Ultima Vogue 2 can handle sweat, splashes, and dust. Wear it to the gym, on your commute, or outdoors without worry; it’s designed to keep up with your daily routine.

100+ Sports Modes: Whether you're hitting the cricket pitch, running indoors, or practicing yoga, dedicated workout modes track every single calorie burnt. Featuring strength training, football, cricket, yoga, golf, and more, it also comes with Auto-Activity Detection for running and walking to map your movement seamlessly.
